Root CMR expected-parent authoring decision: adopt contextual treatment of ONLY the exact 7,081 expected-parent interior incidences across 4,497 pending original map cells and 73 targets in the reviewed proposal.

Immutable scope: proposal SHA-256 18da1200fadd42806e7e02e9f1565aff366fa531f9ff2571f8e1125e92b41d26, from the existing 64-file handoff at https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/issues/2649#issuecomment-6392247000 . Archive SHA-256 b08cd6074a3ef9516733f8b2115a2cac0586aea9fe2c2bd6934cae1b544ce5c2. Independent exact checks SHA-256 bc93a4091f4a11053c40aab19b15150e68b531f8485ae9b40a82bcdd63e65260; substantive assessment SHA-256 ef7615b329a382b037432c61bc7e4e6a4fc3d2b21fed6503ba851589bc798825. Root read the full assessment. This summary contains no raw coordinates or geometry.

Actual institutional clauses, target-specific parent mappings and source applications establish that these enumerated region/department representations are the documented containing institutions of the intended local subjects, not mutually exclusive alternative local owners. This is not an inference from country or administrative level alone. It asserts neither geometric nesting, identical epoch, boundary accuracy, common extent nor sovereignty.

All original target-specific source IDs, ordinals, geometry identities and measured contacts remain intact. The four distinct Ndian/Sanaga source records remain distinct, not merged or discarded. Baschéo's Bénoué/Nord institutional membership does not repair its contrary local map or clear the separate Mayo-Louti contact. Explicit aliases and urban-unit relationships are limited to the retained actual readings.

The scope partitions into 4,008 parent-only, 429 parent-plus-foreign, 54 parent-plus-contrary and 6 three-way map cells. Preserve all 489 competing-key contexts and their actual evidence, all 33 CAF2 conflicts, all 33 original water-class subjects, every nonadopted foreign/contrary operand and accepted Ndélélé. Only the separate exact CAF1 decision at comment 6392132643 affects its own enumerated incidences; this parent decision does not expand it. Local source-extent adverses, map ambiguities and actual unperformed qualification steps remain operative.

Team 2 may author this exactly bound parent decision through the existing supported applicability route, preserving provenance and all original source/patch/physical identities. Combine it coherently with the already adopted CAF1 input before the ONE genuinely necessary changed-semantics full-original diagnostic; do not rerun unchanged geometry per subgroup or decision. Subsequent actual physical/native qualification and current-owner conservation still determine which candidates qualify. Do not forecast that all parent-only cases pass or automatically accept water classes.

This is an authoring decision, NOT positive acceptance, researched-unresolved credit, source replacement or consumer weakening. Original CMR remains 4,925 = 1 accepted +4,924 pending. Prior diagnostic support counts are not added to accepted totals. No package completion or global scorecard change occurs here.
